name: Moose DPV Annotation
description: Annotates text with concepts from the W3C Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV): personal data categories, purposes, processing operations, legal bases and more. LLM-based NER by SINTEF's Moose service.

operations.label: Annotate text with DPV
operations.description: Sends the text of each input file to Moose, waits for the job (queued, processing, completed or failed) and publishes its result: {entities: [{start, end, text, type_id, confidence}], warnings?}.

parameters.name: vocabulary
parameters.label: DPV vocabulary
parameters.description: dpv: the full Data Privacy Vocabulary. dpv_pd: the DPV personal data categories extension.

parameters.name: llm_provider
parameters.label: LLM provider
parameters.description: Provider Moose uses for the annotation. Ollama does not need an LLM API key.

parameters.name: llm_model
parameters.label: LLM model
parameters.description: Provider-specific model name, e.g. anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet (OpenRouter), deepseek-chat, or llama3.1:8b (Ollama).

parameters.name: llm_endpoint
parameters.label: LLM endpoint override
parameters.description: Optional custom endpoint for the LLM provider (e.g. a self-hosted Ollama URL).

secrets.name: moose_api_key
secrets.label: Moose API key
secrets.description: Key for the Moose service, from the Moose maintainers (SINTEF).

secrets.name: llm_api_key
secrets.label: LLM provider API key
secrets.description: Your key for the selected LLM provider (OpenRouter, DeepInfra, DeepSeek). Not needed for Ollama.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: UTF-8 text (e.g. a privacy notice, contract or data description) to annotate.

outputs.name: dpv_annotations
outputs.description: JSON {"entities": [{"start", "end", "text", "type_id", "confidence"}], "warnings"?: [...]}: character offsets into the input text, the matched span, the DPV concept id and the model's confidence.

instructions: Use when a pipeline must identify privacy and data-protection concepts in text according to the W3C Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV): personal data categories, processing purposes, operations, legal bases, recipients, technical and organisational measures. Choose vocabulary dpv_pd to focus on personal data categories. Input must be plain UTF-8 text, one document per input file; convert PDFs to text first. Runs asynchronously and may take a few minutes per document. With Output 'Input with annotations' the step publishes its input (e.g. a transcript) with the DPV result under 'dpv', so a later step in a chain still gets the text. Not for tables or general named-entity recognition.
